## Problem and Result

Describe the user-visible trigger and resulting behavior. Link an issue or affected requirement IDs where relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually executed and their outcomes. Identify missing native targets or other untested limits. Documentation-only changes still require link/provenance validation.

## Scope and Security

Describe changes to capabilities, persistence, remote effects, dependencies or acceptance, if any. Do not attach credentials, real endpoints, user files, raw terminal bodies or unreviewed diagnostic dumps. Confirm that excluded features and existing safety contracts remain respected.
